proposed_facts.reason: Verified counter initialization to 12, decrement-before-transition timing, outward facing, equality preservation and rotation-dependent turn setup.

Damage clears Food before recovery. The animation samples actor root motion, while the nullable accessory callback positions Food from actor position; the shared inline independently confirms velocity derivation.
State-4 collision handles reversal and departure reentry after the demonstrated damage route has cleared Food.
Flee_Coll distinguishes accelerated departure from ordinary flight, matches the retained physics name and resolves the observed rendered Fly_Coll collision without claiming a historical identifier.
Verified saved terrain result, short-circuit wall guard, reversal priority, unscaled speed write, 20-update turn, alternate departure reentry and false return.

Canonical code uses s32** and the stated cast expression, while the launch helper separately uses f32*. All attachment, velocity, conditional-helper and state-selection effects match. Attribute-layout interpretation is appropriately deferred.
Verified numeric state-table animation IDs and reaction routes. Only ordinary-flight physics invokes the local bounds helper; no state-2 recovery transition appears in this unit.

The recovery-physics explanation incorrectly described inward facing. Proposal 0 resolves this while preserving the zero-start transition and equality exception.

The animation and collision game mappings incorrectly implied continued Food carriage or direct food-bone attachment. Proposals 1 and 2 preserve the cleared attachment lifetime and distinguish actor velocity from Food positioning.

The duplicate Fly_Coll name and inward/cruising collision explanation are resolved by proposals 3 and 4. Canonical behavior distinguishes accelerated departure and preserves the unscaled collision write.

Proposal 5 corrects the unsupported flat-float/floor threshold interpretation and avoids assigning normalization semantics to the damage-velocity helper. The mixed attribute layout remains explicitly unresolved.
Proposal 6 corrects attribution of local boundary cleanup to state 4. State-1 physics calls the helper; state-4 physics does not. Broader lifecycle handling is not inferred.
